Long_Description: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

Short_Description: Use TACTICAL DOCTRINE an extra time
Long_Description: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

Long_Description: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to charge rolls.
Friendly TACTICUS units can re-roll advance rolls.

Short_Description: TACTICUS: RAPID FIRE active at max range
Long_Description: Friendly TACTICUS units’ [RAPID FIRE] attacks benefit from [RAPID FIRE] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

Short_Description:
PHOBOS / SCOUT after SHOOTING:
Stay HIDDEN or Move D6"
If Move: Cannot CHARGE
Long_Description:
When a friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot:
• Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
• Or: That unit can make a normal move up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Short_Description:
End MOVEMENT: HIDDEN PHOBOS
Attacks: Re-roll WOUND 1s
Long_Description: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly PHOBOS unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

Short_Description: After NORMAL MOVE: RANGED lose HEAVY & +1 Hit
Long_Description:
In a turn a friendly GRAVIS unit made a normal move, that unit’s ranged attacks:
• Do not have [HEAVY].
• Have +1 to hit rolls.

Short_Description:
GRAVIS on OBJECTIVE
vs S > T: -1 to Wound
Long_Description: While a friendly GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +2" M.
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Short_Description: Each phase, unit [re-roll 1 Hit, Wound or Damage roll].

VEHICLE RANGED, excluding WALKER
Re-roll one Hit roll & one Wound roll
Long_Description:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units (excluding WALKER units) ranged attacks can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Re-roll one wound roll.
Tags: SHOOT, WEAPONS, RE-ROLL ONE HIT ROLL, RE-ROLL ONE WOUND ROLL

Short_Description:
TRANSPORT hits enemy → ASSAILED
Disembarked UNIT vs ASSAILED: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
Long_Description:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn:
• While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
